Mira (Sales): Heads-up — Rapidsample wants us to run a throughput validation next Tue. Goal they quoted: 1k QPS sustained for 20m, p50 ~100ms, p99 <500ms. They also asked about encryption & KMS latency. Can we scope a runbook and cost estimate?

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Cool. Proposed approach: 1) hosted Dedicated warm pool (reserved capacity) 2) Poisson ramp to 1k qps over 5m, hold 20m, then ramp-down 2m. Need workload mix: are these chat-style streaming calls or short completions? avg tokens in/out? max_seq? Also: will they insist on customer KMS (HSM) for keys?

Mira (Sales): Customer says mixed: 70% short completions (~40 tokens in / 80 tokens out), 30% multi-turn chat (avg context 1024). They prefer us to use their KMS (HSM) for at-rest model keys. They also want a price band and whether Dedicated or Private is required for SLA.

Kai (Runtime Eng): For 1k QPS with that mix we can probably hit it on a Dedicated fleet of A10s/m40s depending on model size. Quick notes: batching=8 and concurrency per worker=16 tends to minimize p50 while keeping p99 decent for short tokens. Two technical risks: 1) HSM KMS calls add ~15-40ms per initial decrypt if we have to call KMS inline (depends on VPC egress path). 2) Long chat context (1024) increases KV cache pressure — watch memory and cache eviction which can spike p99.

Kai (Runtime Eng): Sample load snippet for their test harness (local runner):

```bash
# simplified pseudo-runner using hey-like tool
loadgen --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  --concurrency 250 --rate 1000 --duration 1400s \ 
  --payload-file profile_mixed.json \ 
  --headers 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

Jamal (Solutions Eng): profile_mixed.json should include the 70/30 mix and token distributions. We'll generate a set of 5 seed prompts and a short/long set to simulate KV cache reuse. Also recommend we run a small smoke at 200 qps for 10m first to warm caches, then ramp.

Olga (Security): On KMS/HSM — if they insist on customer-managed keys, we need the KMS endpoint topology and SLA for KMS. If KMS sits in another cloud region, remote decrypt latency kills our p99. Also need confirmation on required compliance — they ticked SOC2 + HIPAA. That changes logging and retention requirements (redact PII in traces).

Mira (Sales): Pricing ask: give me a rough run-only estimate (one-off) and delta vs committed Dedicated. They want a figure to include in their procurement note.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Quick calc: estimate tokens/sec = QPS * avg tokens out (assuming 80 tokens avg) => 1000 * 80 = 80k tokens/sec. For a 20m steady-state (1200s) that's 96M tokens generated. If hosted per-token price is $0.0006 per 1k tokens (example), cost ≈ 96M/1k * $0.0006 = $57.6. That sounds low because infra and GPU time dominate at scale — include a run premium and instance-hours. Ballpark: $8–12k for a fully-instrumented Dedicated-run (includes ops support, extra retention, and HSM overhead). If they commit to a small Dedicated reservation we can credit some run hours.

Kai (Runtime Eng): Ops note: to be conservative, include extra margin for cold-starts and tail smoothing (x1.4). Also if we proxy KMS we should pre-warm key material in the local vault so decrypts don't go to HSM on every request. That reduces KMS latency risk.

Mira (Sales): Ok — can we make a runbook and a short cost breakdown PDF by EOW? I want a neat number for procurement.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): Yes. I'll draft a runbook: prerequisites, smoke step, main ramp, monitoring checklist (p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU saturation, KV evictions, KMS latency), rollback triggers (p99 > 1s for >2m or GPU mem > 90%).

Olga (Security): I need them to fill our short KMS/PAL questionnaire before we touch keys. I'll drop a link. Also: if they require private network peering we need network team lead time ~5 business days.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created: run-1749994321-rapidsample (owner: Jamal). Start window: 2025-03-11T15:00Z — tentative.

Kai (Runtime Eng): Action items for eng: 1) Generate profile_mixed.json and seed tokens (Jamal) 2) Add pre-warm KMS step and test decrypt latency (Kai) 3) Reserve Dedicated fleet with batch size 8 / concurrency 16 (Ops) 4) Prepare dashboard and alert rules (p99, kv_evictions, kms_rt) (Jamal/Kai).

Mira (Sales): I'll confirm procurement timeline and ask them if they can accept our temporary key proxy (if HSM certs not available) to avoid delays. Also pushing for a committed 1-week Dedicated trial to reduce per-run unit cost.

Jamal (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble the runbook + cost breakdown and link it here when ready. Expected draft by Fri EOD.

Mira (Sales): Great. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Kai (Runtime Eng): Noted. I'll run a quick local KMS decrypt benchmark today and post numbers (expect 20–35ms for regional HSM, >80ms if cross-region).

Olga (Security): I'll follow up with the questionnaire and note the SOC2/HIPAA implications for logging.

Mira (Sales): Closing loop — once we have the runbook and pricing we can schedule customer sync.
